name: omnisense/omniticket
description: Omniticket: tickets sold elsewhere, read and checked under any PHP host - the events a ticketing service sells (dates, rates, places left, sold out, where to buy), who comes (attendees), and whether a ticket code is valid at the door, one contract whoever sells them. Providers are packages of their own (omniticket/weezevent, omniticket/billetweb, omniticket/helloasso, omniticket/eventbrite, omniticket/ticketmaster); the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.omniticket/billetweb: Billetweb: events, rates and places left, attendees, ticket check
suggest.omniticket/eventbrite: Eventbrite: an organization's events, ticket classes, attendees, ticket check
suggest.omniticket/helloasso: HelloAsso: an association's event forms, tiers, registrations, ticket check
suggest.omniticket/ticketmaster: Ticketmaster's Discovery API: public events, read-only
suggest.omniticket/weezevent: Weezevent: events, rates, sessions, participants, ticket check
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire a family into their host
